10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:2c3123bb-eba2-43.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Pricing Manager – AI Trainer (Freelance, 8–20 hrs/week, Remote EU/UK) Are you a seasoned professional in pricing strategy, quantitative analysis, or financial modeling? Are you interested in helping shape the future of artificial intelligence by teaching AI to reason about real-world pricing methodologies? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Pricing Manager AI Trainer and contribute your expertise to advanced AI education—flexibly, remotely, and on your schedule. About Us 10x Team connects freelance professionals with leading AI labs to develop next-generation AI models. We are seeking Pricing Managers based in the EU or UK to ensure AI-generated outputs meet the practical standards and nuanced decision-making expected in industry. Key Responsibilities: - Review and enhance AI-generated content related to pricing strategy, margin analysis, and competitive positioning - Evaluate the realism, relevance, and analytical rigor of pricing methodologies proposed by AI - Draft example scenarios, case studies, and calculations using your pricing expertise - Create scenario variations reflecting viewpoints such as pricing analysts, business managers, and clients - Identify flawed assumptions, unrealistic pricing models, or compliance gaps and provide clear, actionable feedback In essence: You will use your pricing experience to help AI better understand and reason about effective, robust pricing strategies and frameworks. About You: - Senior Pricing Manager or similar, with hands-on experience in pricing, financial modeling, or analytics - Based in the EU or UK - Demonstrated expertise in reviewing pricing strategies, conducting margin analysis, and implementing pricing controls - Highly organized and able to communicate direct, constructive feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week with reliable, timely responses Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance work—100% remote - Use your industry expertise to build smarter AI systems - Direct impact: teach AI about complex pricing challenges and approaches - Free access to our AI Academy for upskilling - Structured onboarding, clear briefs, ongoing collaborative projects How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the future of AI-driven pricing analysis—apply today! #LI-TT1 ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. Why 9 Mothers? While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. The Perception Lead is responsible for the research, development, and deployment of the perception pipeline that enables EDDA to engage aerial threats in real time. This is a senior individual contributor position. Essential Duties - Own the visual perception pipeline end-to-end, including detection, classification, and tracking of sUAS targets in real time. - Design and train machine learning models that meet latency and accuracy requirements for edge deployment on Jetson-class hardware. - Architect and maintain the dataset and simulation pipeline, including data collection, labeling, curation, augmentation, synthetic data generation, and closed-loop retraining based on field performance. - Optimize inference performance on Jetson platforms, including model pruning, quantization, TensorRT integration, and custom kernel development as required. - Establish the model evaluation framework and metrics used to assess perception performance under operational conditions. - Deliver target state information (position, velocity, identity, uncertainty) to the controls subsystem. - Collaborate with the hardware team on camera, optics, and sensor selection. Requirements - 6+ years of professional experience in computer vision or machine learning, including production deployment on edge hardware. - Demonstrated experience shipping a detection or tracking system under real-world latency, small-object, or adversarial constraints. - Strong engineering skills beyond modeling, including experience with PyTorch or JAX through to deployed, optimized inference. - Proficiency in Python for model development and C++ or Rust for deployed inference. - U.S. citizenship and ability to pass a background check. Nice-to-Have - Experience working with infrared (IR), thermal, or multi-spectrum camera systems. - TensorRT and NVIDIA Jetson deployment experience at production scale. - Multi-object tracking under challenging conditions. - Multi-modal sensor fusion experience (EO/IR, radar, acoustic). - Synthetic data generation and sim-to-real methodologies. - Prior experience in defense or other safety-critical computer vision applications. - Active security clearance, or eligibility to obtain one. - A passion for building robots or engineering projects as a hobby. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one. - Mission-Critical Work: We don't build for "what if." assistworld-assist-world:lever:91b3313b-.title: Virtual Assistant – eBay & Whatnot Listings
assistworld-assist-world:lever:91b3313b-.description: Company Overview The client has been a full-time reseller of toys and collectibles for 6–7 years, operating primarily on eBay with Whatnot as a secondary platform. The business focuses on hard goods — mostly action figures and collectibles (e.g. Marvel Legends) — and has been steadily growing. It has largely been a one-person operation, with occasional help from the owner's wife. Role Overview As inventory volume has grown, the owner can no longer keep up with creating listings at the pace he'd like. He's looking for a Virtual Assistant to take the listing-drafting work off his plate: turning product photos into ready-to-review listing drafts on eBay and Whatnot, so he can focus on sourcing, fulfillment, and growing the business. He will always do a final review and post the listings himself, so the goal is drafts that are as close to 'ready to launch' as possible. Key Responsibilities • Turn product photos sent by the client into listing drafts on eBay and Whatnot. • Research and fill in accurate item details — title, brand, franchise, character, theme/family, and other item specifics — using tools like Google Lens and comparable/competitor listings, supplemented by information the client provides. • Write eBay titles that follow the client's standardized style (e.g. 'Marvel Legends, Storm, action figure'), adapting to his preferences over time. • Build out full eBay listings with the level of detail eBay's category/item-specifics fields require (theme, franchise, character family, etc.) so listings surface correctly in buyer searches. • Build simpler Whatnot listings, which need far less detail — primarily an accurate title. • Leave all listings in draft form for the client's final review, edits, and posting — not publish listings directly. Skills & Tools • Comfortable navigating eBay's listing tools and item-specifics/category fields; Whatnot experience a plus but not required. • Resourceful at identifying unfamiliar items using tools like Google Lens and by cross-referencing similar/competitor listings. • Detail-oriented and consistent — able to learn and replicate a standardized title/listing style over time. • Comfortable working with toys, collectibles, and pop-culture/franchise items (Marvel, etc.); no prior fandom knowledge required, just willingness to learn. • Reliable, reasonable turnaround on batches of photos sent by the client (same-day/next-day, not same-hour). Logistics • Starts at 10 hours/week, with potential to grow to 20–30+ hours/week as volume increases.

campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:7ac6146e-c764-.title: Field Marketing Manager
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:7ac6146e-c764-.description: Field Marketing Manager · New York City · Full-time, in-market THE ROLE New York is where many of our highest-value buyers already are. We are hiring a Field Marketing Manager to turn that density into a pipeline — through tradeshows, community programs, hackathons, executive dinners, and hospitality experiences that people actually remember. This is an owner's role, not a coordinator's. You will decide which shows are worth attending, which communities are worth investing in, who belongs at which dinner table, and where the next dollar goes. You will work shoulder to shoulder with Sales, and you will be measured on the pipeline your programs create and accelerate. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own the NYC event portfolio — strategy, budget, execution, and reporting across a range of program types - Tradeshows: select and tier shows against our target accounts, design the booth experience, and hold the team to pre-show outreach and post-show follow-up. - Communities: build a sustained presence with NYC practitioner communities and peer networks — recurring formats, real partnerships, and customer advocates on stage. - Hackathons: partner with Product and Engineering to run events that earn technical credibility and get builders using the product. - Executive dinners: curate small, high-signal rooms of senior buyers, built account by account with Sales, with follow-up that converts. - Hospitality: design sports, culture, and dining experiences tied to named deals, with clear allocation rules and compliance guardrails. - Build and negotiate budgets across vendors, venues, sponsorships, software, and agencies — and defend the ROI. - Report honestly on what worked and what did not, and present plans and results to the wider GTM team. - Leave a process behind — playbooks, templates, and SLAs so every program is repeatable and scalable to the next market. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - 4–7 years in field marketing, events, or experiential marketing, including B2B with a sales-led motion. - A track record of running events independently, end to end, with minimal oversight. - Range across event types — you have done the big show and the eight-person dinner, and you know they are different jobs. - Strong Sales partnership skill: you can build an invite list account by account, push back on low-leverage asks, and chase follow-up. - Data fluency: you build plans from account and performance data and can talk about cost per meeting without flinching. - Strong negotiation instincts with vendors, venues, and agencies. - Excellent presence in front of a room, including senior internal audiences. - Based in NYC, with willingness to work evenings and travel to EMEA Nice to have - Experience with technical or developer audiences (hackathons, builder communities). - Existing NYC venue, agency, and community relationships. - Experience selling to or marketing to finance and accounting leaders. - Experience mentoring junior marketers or managing agency teams. HOW WE WILL KNOW IT IS WORKING Within a year, the NYC portfolio has a defensible cost per qualified meeting, a repeatable playbook for each program type, and pipeline contribution that the sales team would happily defend in a QBR.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0cd64ee9-57b0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Content and Social Media Manager based in Germany. As a Content and Social Media Manager, you’ll own the editorial engine across multiple channels, creating content that strengthens brand visibility and generates qualified business opportunities. You’ll combine strong writing skills with strategic thinking to produce authoritative content for blogs, websites, sales materials, press communications, and email campaigns. A major part of the role will involve building a compelling LinkedIn presence through distinctive narratives, relevant insights, and experimentation with new formats. You’ll work closely with subject matter experts, marketers, product teams, and senior leaders to turn complex ideas into clear, credible, engaging stories. The role offers significant creative ownership, from planning the editorial calendar through writing, publishing, performance analysis, and optimization. You’ll join a fast-moving international environment where initiative, curiosity, and a willingness to experiment are highly valued. This is an ideal opportunity for a hands-on content professional who wants to shape a growing B2B technology brand through exceptional writing and social storytelling. Write and edit long-form content, including blog articles, bylined pieces, data-driven reports, one-pagers, and website copy. Transform input from internal experts into authoritative, accessible content that delivers meaningful value to a professional B2B audience. Lead day-to-day social media execution across LinkedIn and emerging channels, developing compelling content and testing new formats and narratives. Develop and manage press releases related to product launches, partnerships, licensing milestones, company announcements, and other significant developments. Coordinate press distribution with relevant trade publications, media outlets, and external PR partners. Adapt existing and newly produced video content for social media in collaboration with marketing and creative stakeholders. Monitor content and social media performance, identify successful formats and topics, and adjust the editorial strategy based on results. Collaborate with marketing leadership, subject matter experts, traders, product managers, and executives to develop credible and engaging stories. Continuously explore new content approaches, formats, tools, and workflows to strengthen the effectiveness of the editorial operation. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience in content marketing, editorial, communications , or a closely related field, ideally within B2B technology. A portfolio demonstrating strong long-form and short-form content that you have personally written, developed, and published. Proven experience using LinkedIn as a B2B content and marketing channel , with a strong understanding of what drives engagement and business impact. Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to develop compelling narratives and adapt tone and format to different audiences and channels. Demonstrated ability to translate complex or technical input from subject matter experts into clear, credible, and engaging content. Strong editorial judgment and a willingness to experiment with emerging content formats and storytelling approaches. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership in a fast-moving environment without requiring a detailed playbook. Strong analytical mindset and ability to use content and social performance data to inform future decisions. Experience in iGaming, esports, betting, gaming, or another regulated industry is an advantage. Familiarity with HubSpot is a plus. Experience working within a startup or scale-up en

Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, time management, and ability to prioritize competing initiatives. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and levels of seniority. Proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership and follow-through. Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and support team members while fostering collaboration and accountability. Must be authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Ability to work beyond 40 hours when business needs require it. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6fedeebe-d1a3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager (AI Products) based in South Africa. This is a hands-on Technical Project Management opportunity for a professional who can lead AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and iteration. You will combine delivery leadership with strong business analysis skills, turning complex business, clinical, and market goals into clear, actionable requirements. The role offers substantial ownership across scope, planning, stakeholder alignment, quality, governance, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineering teams and need enough technical fluency to engage confidently in architecture discussions and challenge assumptions. The environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than simply managing schedules. You will also have opportunities to introduce automation, AI tooling, and efficient processes that improve delivery quality and reduce operational overhead. Lead AI-first projects end-to-end, from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration. Translate business, clinical, and market objectives into clear, actionable, and technically feasible requirements. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues while maintaining strong delivery discipline. Coordinate standups, Scrum ceremonies, stakeholder communications, project updates, and vendor activities as required. jobgether-jobgether:lever:cf0ebbdb-34d4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Saudi Arabia. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional-development purposes. Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation. Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization. Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity. Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision-making. Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs. Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities. Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another. Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered. Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty. Brief decision-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non-technical stakeholders. Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment. Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates. Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions. Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization. In this role, you'll work closely with engineers on technical challenges while helping the team navigate ambiguity, make thoughtful decisions, and deliver with speed and quality. Rather than directing every solution, you'll facilitate productive technical discussions, build alignment, and create the conditions for our engineers to do their best work. We're looking for someone who can think strategically, stay close enough to the technical work to understand trade-offs, ask good questions, and help guide technical decisions, while leading through influence rather than authority. You'll help the team balance long-term technical investments with near-term execution, maintain a high bar for engineering quality, and create the clarity and alignment that enables engineers to move quickly without sacrificing thoughtful decision-making.
